params._developer: Developer wallet — receives 30%. Can update itself via setDeveloper().
params._initialFee: Initial lookup fee in USDC (6 decimals). E.g. 5000000 = $5.00.
params.initialOwner: Treasury wallet — owns the contract and controls admin functions.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

checkExists(string).notice: Free check: returns whether a query is flagged plus reporter/timestamp.         Does NOT return evidence URL or description — those require the paid lookup.

deactivateRecord(bytes32).notice: Deactivate a fake/erroneous report. Frees the handle slot for re-submission.

developer().notice: Developer wallet — receives 30% of every lookup fee.         Can only be updated by the current developer via setDeveloper().

getRecordKeysPaginated(uint256,uint256).notice: Paginated record keys. offset=0, limit=50 to get first page; increment offset for next.         Returns (page, total) so caller knows when to stop.

getRecordsByReporter(address).notice: O(1) — returns this reporter's record keys directly from their own index.         Returns newest-first by reversing the append-order array.

getReporterListPaginated(uint256,uint256.notice: Paginated reporter list. offset=0, limit=50 to get first page.         Returns (page, total) so caller knows when to stop.

reactivateRecord(bytes32).notice: Reactivate a previously deactivated report. Re-indexes the handle/wallet slots.

setDeveloper(address).notice: Only the current developer can call this.

setTreasury(address).notice: Update the treasury wallet. Also transfers Ownable ownership so they stay in sync.

treasury().notice: Treasury wallet — receives 50% of every lookup fee.         Also the contract owner (Ownable). setTreasury transfers ownership too.
